interpretation: Relative civic pressure within the frozen 27-region Jawa Barat 2023 cohort; not absolute quality of life, government performance, a probability or causal effect. Indicator endpoints 0 and 100 are cohort-relative, not theoretical real-world bounds.

provenance.evidenceVerificationScope: Repository frozen audited inputs and source receipts verified by fingerprint. Original remote publications are not reacquired or newly byte-verified by this offline scorer.
provenance.sourceMetadataPolicy: Each indicator's frozenIndicatorPointer and each observation's frozenValuePointer resolve in freezePath. Frozen indicator/observation records retain definitions, geography, periods, denominators, revisions, missingness, uncertainty, source artifacts and audit provenance. normalizationValuePointer resolves in normalizationPath.

explainabilityPolicy.dimensionExtrema: All exact-equality highest/lowest dimension ties, in frozen dimension order; no rounding before comparisons.
explainabilityPolicy.indicatorPressureOrdering: Descending unrounded normalized pressure, with frozen indicator order for exact ties. Ordering is not a weight or a causal attribution.
explainabilityPolicy.contributions: Indicator-to-dimension = normalized pressure * within weight; dimension-to-overall = dimension score * dimension weight; indicator-to-overall = normalized pressure * effective weight. Units are score points, not shares of residents.
